title: Spring cart: friction measured with no ruler in sight
description: A glider on a track between two springs, filmed for 15 s with nothing of known size in view. Frequency and friction don't need a scale: the swing shrinks by about the same amount every cycle, so PhysicsLens accepts a spring with dry (sliding) friction over the undamped and viscous-damping laws, on held-out motion.
